Summary: BUG-013: Login can be bypassed by forging an unsigned session cookie
Environment: https://www.saucedemo.com, Chrome (Chromium), user none (no password needed)
Description:
*Severity:* Critical
*Found:* 2026-11-05
*Failed test cases:* TC-065, TC-066

*Steps to reproduce*
# Open a fresh private window on https://www.saucedemo.com (not logged in)
# In the browser tools add a cookie for www.saucedemo.com: name session-username, value standard_user, path /
# Open https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html

*Expected result*
Redirected to the login page. A session must be proven with a password and be an unguessable, signed value, with HttpOnly and Secure set.

*Actual result*
The shop opens as standard_user with no password. The same works for problem_user (and any other username); only locked_out_user is turned away. The cookie holds the plain username, HttpOnly is false, Secure is false, SameSite is Lax, lifetime about 10 minutes.

*Evidence:* forged-cookie-access.png (attach from the evidence folder of the repository)

Summary: BUG-020: The cart cannot be reached or opened with the keyboard
Description:
*Severity:* Critical
*Found:* 2026-11-05
*Failed test cases:* TC-086, TC-087

*Steps to reproduce*
# Log in as standard_user
# Press Tab repeatedly from the top of the products page (40 presses are enough to pass every control)
# Watch which controls receive focus, then focus the cart icon by script and press Enter or Space

*Expected result*
The cart link receives focus in the Tab order and Enter opens the cart (WCAG 2.1 success criterion 2.1.1 Keyboard, level A).

*Actual result*
Tab goes through the menu, sort, every product link and button, but never reaches the cart icon. It is an <a role="button" data-test="shopping-cart-link"> with no href and no tabindex. Pressing Enter or Space on it (focused by script) does nothing. A keyboard-only shopper cannot open the cart, so cannot check out. The automated axe scan reported no violation for it. Found while writing the automated keyboard test, after the first manual keyboard pass had missed it.

*Evidence:* n/a (keyboard behaviour) (attach from the evidence folder of the repository)
